note: City of Aberdeen campground in 210-acre Wylie Park, 1 mi north of town on US-281, in two loops on the park road: the South Campground (sites 1-92, beside the campground lodge) and the smaller all-full-hookup North Campground (sites 100-122). Cabins and tent sites too. Storybook Land and the Land of Oz (free admission), a lake, trails and a recreation path are in the park; the Brown County Fair (mid-August) is next door. AAA members also get 10% off. --Claude
